content: Šekim edde Dina
Ar Lear zi Dina, zare hibaye Yakubolla biyail, hibaye dešor mayafuwain okkol loi dola oibolla baire gil.
Ar he elehar šašon goroya, Hibbi Hamoror fut Šekime hibare deikke, hite hibare loi zaiyore hiba loi neiṭṭe edde hibar ijjot hani goijje.
Ar hitar dil Yakubor zi Dinar uwore foijje; hite hibare ador goijje edde hibar loi ador muhabbotor hota okkol hoiye.
Toi Šekime hitar baf Hamorore hodde, "Ei mayafuware ãr bou hisabe ani do."
Yakube fuinne ze hite hibar zi Dinar ijjot hani goijje, ar hibar futain okkol zanuwaror zãk loi maṛot aššil; hetolla Yakube hitara górot firi no aiye foijjonto nizam mari taikke.
Bade Šekimor baf Hamor šohorottu niyoli zai Yakub loi hota hoito aišše.

Ar Yakubor futain okkole oi hóbor funi mottor hitara maṛottu firi aišše, ar hitarar dile beši duk faiye edde guššaye oin oiye, kiyollahoile Yakubor ziyor ijjot hani goriyore Šekime Israilor loi ekkan ofomanor ham goijje, ziyan hitattu muṭe o goron nuwaššil.
Kintu Hamore hitarare hodde, "Tũwar he ziyor uwore ãr fut Šekimor foran fori taikke. Meherbani gori hitalla hibare hitar bou hisabe do.
Ar ãrar loi biya dola goro, tũwarar ziyain okkolore ãrare do, ar ãrar ziyain okkolore tũwaralla lo.
Tũwara ãrar fũwati bošoti goro; deš tũwarar sarme fori roiye, tũwara eṛe šodori goro edde dón šombottir malik o."
Ar Šekime Dinar baf edde báiyaindore hodde, "Ãr mikka tũwara rahamotor nozore so, ar tũwara ãttu ziyan saiba ãi hiyan diyum.
Ei bouwor mohorana edde hadiya tũwara zedun dabi goitto so goro, tũwara hodde mozin ãi diyum, to ei zuwan mayafuwaware bou hisabe do."
Šekime hitarar boin Dinar ijjot hani goijjilde hetolla, Yakubor futainde hitare edde hitar baf Hamorore dúha loi zuwab diye.
Hitara hitarare hodde, "Ãra ei ham gori no faijjum, ekzon azomi agoraiya manušore ãrar boinore diya iyan ãralla ekkan beši šoromor ham oibo.
Bolke ei ekkan ham gorile ãra tũwarar loi razi oi fariyumde: tũwara o zodi ãrar ḍoilla, tũwarar furuš okkole azomi gorao,
toi ãra tũwarare ãrar ziyaindore diyum, ar tũwarar ziyaindore o ãralla loiyum, ãra tũwar fũwati bošoti goijjum edde ek zati oiyum.
Ar zodi ãrar hota no funo edde azomi goraiya no o, toile ãra ãrar ziyore loi zaiyumboi."
Hitarar hota Hamor edde hitar fut Šekimor nozorot bala laigge.
Toi ei zuwan ze hitar bafor góror beši ijjotwala, hite hitara hoiyede hiyan furon goitte deri no gore, kiyollahoile Yakubor ziyor uwore hitattu beši mon foijje.
Bade Hamor edde hitar fut Šekime hitarar šohor geiṛot aišše, ar hitara šohoror manuš okkol loi hota hoiye.

Hitara hodde, "Ei manušgun ãra loi šanti, itarare ei dešot bošoti goitto do edde šodori goitto do, dešot to hitaralla o bout zaga ase. Ãra hitarar ziyaindore ãralla bouwain hisabe loi, ar ãrar ziyain okkol hitarare di.
Kintu ei ekkan ham gorile manuššune ãrar fũwati bošoti goribo edde ek zati oibo. hiyan oilde zodi ãrar fotti furuše hitarar ḍoilla azomi goraiya oi.
Ar hitarar zanuwaror zãk edde hitarar dón šombotti edde hár kissu ki ãrar no oibo ne? Hetolla aiyo ãra hitarar hotat razi oi, toi hitara ãrar fũwati bošobaš goribo."
Ar he šohor geiṛot gilde hár manuš okkole Hamor edde hitar fut Šekimor hota fuinne, toi šohoror hár furuš okkolore azomi gora oiye.
Tin din bade zẽtte hitarattu biš oiye, Dinar báiyain Yakubor dui fute Simeon edde Leviye hitara zar zar toluwar loi zai baza sara šohorot hamela goijje, hár furuš okkolore marifelaiye.
Hitara Hamor edde hitar fut Šekimore toluwar loi haṛifelaiye bade hitara Dinare Šekimor górottu bair goijje edde niyoli giyegoi.
Yakubor futainde mora okkolor heṛe aišše edde šohor luṭfat goijje, kiyollahoile hitara itarar boinor ijjot hani goijjil.
Hitarar goru, sool edde gada, aro za kissu šohoror butore edde maṛot aššil hin beggun itara loiainne.
Ar hitarar hár gura fuwain edde hitarar hár bouwain okkolore bondi goriyore, hitarar hár šombotti edde góror hár kissu luṭ goijje.

Toi Yakube Simeon edde Levire hodde, "Tũwara ei dešor bašinda Kenaniyo edde Perišiyo okkolor hãse ãttu bašfuṛefan goijjo edde ãre bifodot felaiyo. Ãttu manuš hom, ar hitara zodi ãr berudde ekottro oiyore ãre hamela gore, ãi edde ãr góror gušṭi ṭiya dongšo oiyum."
Ar hitara hodde, "Ãrar boinore hite beiššar ḍoil bebar kiyolla goijje?"
